method.s: Mix flour and salt in a medium bowl. Make a deep well and break in eggs. Whisk eggs with a fork, progressively mixing in flour from around the edges.
When a dough forms, turn out onto bench with the rest of the flour. Knead for five minutes, cover to avoid drying out, and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Divide into four balls and roll out on a floured surface. Roll it out thin - should be translucent enough to see your hand through the sheet when held to the light.
Lightly flour, fold the sheet up on itself a few times, and cut to desired width.
Cook in salted boiling water for a few minutes - less than dry pasta.
